items.title: Gucci Spices Up the Fanny Pack for Today's Stylish Gents
items.summary: Philippine fashion outlet Preview.ph covers Gucci's GucciCore fanny pack/crossbody accessories, illustrating the piece with Thai ambassadors Billkin and Gulf Kanawut modelling the double-G logo bags, tying the global GucciCore push to SEA audiences via its Thai brand-ambassador roster.

items.title: Gucci เปิดตัว GucciCore Campaign ในนิวยอร์ก
items.summary: Thai-language L'Officiel Thailand covers Gucci's GucciCore campaign shot by Peter Funch in New York, showcasing wardrobe staples (peacoats, trench coats, suits) from the Times Square runway show, framed for Thai readers as everyday-wearable Demna-era Gucci; no explicit reception data in the piece.

items.title: 'Luxury checked': Pinoys scrutinize politicians' alleged pricey wardrobe choices
items.summary: Philippine outlet reports a TikTok account (@luxurychecked) tracking local politicians allegedly wearing Gucci and other luxury brands, including Laguna Gov. Sol Aragones and Santa Rosa Mayor Arlene Arcillas, amid public anger given the province's low minimum wage; a related Reddit thread drew 2,800 upvotes/430+ comments and the article itself shows 3,119 shares. This is a reputational-proximity risk story (Gucci named as a status symbol in a corruption-optics backlash), not brand-initiated.

items.title: Fans Are 'Disappointed' Over Mariah Carey's 'Depressing' Gucci Holiday Campaign & 'Boring' Styling
items.summary: Roundup of TikTok reactions to Gucci's 2026 Christmas campaign starring Mariah Carey (directed by Harmony Korine); quoted fan comments call the ad "cold," "emotionless," and liken it to a JCPenney ad trying to be luxury -- global story but directly shapes SEA social feeds given Gucci's heavy SEA social reliance on global campaign content.

items.title: BTS Jin สร้างโมเมนต์ไวรัลคู่แรปเปอร์ Nettspend ในงาน Gucci Milan Fashion Week SS26
items.summary: Thai community thread on Pantip (Thailand's top-10 site) discusses a viral moment between Gucci global ambassador BTS Jin and rapper Nettspend at the Gucci Milan Fashion Week SS26 show, reflecting continued Thai fan enthusiasm for Jin's Gucci ambassadorship; page/engagement counts not accessible via search snippet.

items.title: Pantip Gucci tag -- ongoing Thai community threads on Jin/Davika ambassadorships and product talk
items.summary: Aggregated Pantip tag page shows an active stream of Thai-language threads on Gucci: BTS Jin's ambassador activity, Davika Hoorne's Gucci Beauty role, and recurring consumer threads on bag authenticity/purchase advice -- indicating steady grassroots community volume beyond celebrity news, but exact per-thread metrics are not exposed on the aggregator view.

items.title: Gucci selects Shanghai for Demna's Cruise 2028 fashion show
items.summary: Gucci will stage Demna's Cruise 2028 show in Shanghai on 17 May 2027, marking 30 years since its first China store, as the brand doubles down on the Chinese consumer base; relevant to SEA as Gucci's calendar continues to prioritize Greater China/Asia over Southeast Asian markets for flagship cultural moments, reinforcing a regional secondary-market perception.

items.title: Gucci reportedly cuts prices as turnaround pressure builds
items.summary: Reports Gucci quietly cut prices on select handbags, footwear and ready-to-wear (e.g. Mercato tote 20-25% cheaper; some sneakers from EUR800 to EUR560-595) after 13 consecutive quarters of declining sales; notes pricing varies by market so a bag cheaper in Paris may stay pricier in Singapore or Manila, directly bearing on SEA price perception and aspirational-shopper sentiment.

items.title: Gucci La Famiglia: Marina Bay Sands launch
items.summary: Tatler Asia covers the Gucci 'La Famiglia' SS26 preview event at the Marina Bay Sands boutique -- the only Southeast Asian store carrying the Demna-era SS26 collection at the time -- with Thai ambassador Billkin and actor Gulf Kanawut in attendance, positioning Singapore as Gucci's SEA flagship showcase market.

items.title: Asian Celebs at Gucci SS26: Billkin & VIPs in Singapore
items.summary: Feature on the Asian VIP preview of Gucci SS26 at Marina Bay Sands, highlighting Thai ambassador Billkin wearing a full Gucci look (horsebit chain necklace, Jackie bag) greeted by crowds of fans, alongside other regional celebrity guests -- a positive activation story illustrating ambassador-driven fandom pull in SEA.

items.title: Gucci official X: Jin seen in custom Gucci at BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' Paris
items.summary: Gucci's official X account posted global ambassador Jin (BTS) wearing custom Gucci at the BTS World Tour Arirang stop in Paris; brand-owned activation content rather than organic buzz, but widely reshared across SEA Jin/BTS fan accounts given Jin's large Thai/Vietnamese/Filipino fanbase. Engagement metrics not visible via snippet.

items.source: Yahoo News Singapore (reprint, verified historical context)
items.title: Gucci reopens revamped Singapore flagship store at Marina Bay Sands
items.summary: Local Singapore recap confirming the renovated Marina Bay Sands flagship (new wood-toned, horse-mural interior under Demna's retail concept) continues to anchor Gucci's SEA flagship presence; reposted/updated coverage running alongside the SS26 preview news cycle.
